Element 16’s molten sulfur TES design configuration shown in Figure 1 has two major components: (1) internal heat exchanger (HX) pipe assembly, referred to as “internal TES-HX” located within molten sulfur, and (2) a vessel housing molten sulfur that is hermetically sealed and blanketed with inert gas such as nitrogen. The cost model developed follows a Class 3 cost estimate as classified by the Association for the Advancement of Cost Engineering (AACE) International Recommended Practice. The total cost of sulfur TES system is the sum of vessel (tank) cost, sulfur cost, internal TES-HX cost, insulation cost and HTF cost.
